briefs.claim_en: Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander successfully landed near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, establishing India as the first country to achieve this feat.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple sources confirm that the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully landed its Chandrayaan-3 mission's Vikram lander near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, at 6:04 PM IST. This achievement made India the first country to perform a soft landing in the Moon's south polar region. India also became the fourth country overall to successfully perform a soft landing on the Moon. A fact-check from BOOM Fact Check rated as false the claim that China was the first country to land on the Moon's South Pole.
